description: Offline evidence-status snapshot for issue 11 homing readiness and sensorless homing feasibility. This file is documentation/data only and does not approve firmware flashing, GPIO toggling, motor enable, axis motion, hard-stop homing, sensorless homing, probing live devices, or other live hardware action.

blockers.title: Homing readiness is not evidence-backed
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record exact motion controller identity, motor driver enable behavior, selected homing source per axis, endstop or homing input evidence per axis, Z collision review, and reviewed approval before homing readiness can be known.
evidence_fields_required: exact motion controller board and revision
candidate one-axis step, direction, enable, and homing input mapping
endstop or homing input pin, connector, polarity, pull-up or pull-down, and voltage tolerance per axis
reviewed approval record for homing readiness

blockers.title: Sensorless homing feasibility is not evidence-backed
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record exact driver model and datasheet per axis, feedback interface evidence, firmware support, speed/current/threshold constraints, and false-positive/false-negative risk review before sensorless homing feasibility can be known.
evidence_fields_required: exact stepper driver model per axis
datasheet or board documentation for diagnostic or stall feedback
feedback exposure by pin, UART/SPI register, firmware state, or not exposed
firmware support path for driver feedback

blockers.title: Safe no-motion homing readiness test is not evidence-backed
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record exact target identity, reviewed static evidence, rail and logic tolerance evidence, test points, common-reference or isolation plan, and explicit no-motion approval before any powered no-motion homing readiness test.
evidence_fields_required: exact target controller and driver identity
reviewed static source for each candidate endstop or feedback interface
rail voltage and logic tolerance evidence
boot/reset state evidence or unpowered-only scope
test point and measurement equipment plan

blockers.title: Safe one-axis low-speed motion test is not evidence-backed
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record the exact selected axis, verified step/direction/enable/homing input mapping, reduced current/speed/distance/timeout limits, direction convention, emergency stop or power-off path, and explicit approval before any one-axis low-speed motion test.
evidence_fields_required: verified step, direction, enable, and homing input mapping for selected axis
all non-selected axes disabled or otherwise prevented from motion
driver current limit and thermal margin
reduced speed, acceleration, travel distance, and timeout
safe direction convention and soft travel envelope
observable endstop or feedback behavior before hard-stop reliance
emergency stop or power-off path verified without motion
Z exclusion or separate Z collision approval
explicit reviewer approval naming the selected axis

live_action_gates.title: No-motion homing readiness test
evidence_fields_required: exact controller and driver identity evidence
static source for candidate endstop and feedback interfaces

live_action_gates.title: One-axis low-speed motion test
prohibited_actions: Z motion without separate collision approval
evidence_fields_required: selected single axis and verified pin mapping
driver current limit and reduced-current first-test limit
reduced speed, acceleration, distance, and timeout limits
explicit approval naming the selected axis
